description: Hydropower potential assessment in Ghana is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Open Research Knowledge Graph. Hydropower potential assessment identifies suitable river reaches and sites for sustainable electricity generation, particularly in countries with growing energy demand and underutilized water resources such as Nigeria. These assessments aim to quantify available hydropower potential, determine appropriate plant scales, and evaluate site suitability using hydrological, topographic, and economic information. Coverage: Ghana. The portal files it under the publisher Open Research Knowledge Graph. Its tags are Energy Systems. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License.. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and electrification planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
